branch_change_reconstruction.truth_definition: A true event is a nucleotide state change explicitly recorded in the independent simulator event ledger on a uniquely identified rooted-tree edge and genomic site.

homoplasy_recurrent_state_analysis.truth_definition: A true recurrent site contains two or more independent mutation events in the simulator event ledger; recurrence subclasses are parallel, convergent or reversal according to the exact state transitions.

canonical_input_contract.edge_identity: Each rooted edge is identified canonically by the sorted descendant-tip set SHA256; tool-specific node labels are never used as cross-tool identifiers.
canonical_input_contract.pastml_adapter: Only variable nucleotide sites are converted to one categorical column per site. A,C,G,T are literal states; N or missing observations are encoded as missing, never as a fifth biological state.
canonical_input_contract.snp_only_adapters: Where a tool accepts a SNP table/VCF rather than a full alignment, the adapter is derived deterministically from the same canonical tip alignment and root coordinates.
canonical_input_contract.variable_site_coordinate_system: 1-based coordinates on the frozen 10,000-bp root sequence

canonical_output_contract.ambiguous_or_probabilistic_calls: Primary scoring requires a single discrete event/site call. If a method reports posterior probabilities, threshold selection must be frozen before canonical execution and must not be tuned on benchmark truth.

dependency_policy.independent_algorithm_summary: Any count/ranking of independent algorithm families must collapse TreeTime-dependent workflows into one dependency family while still showing workflow-level results.
dependency_policy.primary_reporting: Report all eight software workflows individually, but explicitly group TreeTime, SNPPar and POUTINE as a dependency-linked family. Do not interpret them as three algorithmically independent confirmations.

method_specific_notes.FastML: Respect academic-use/modification terms; do not vendor restricted source into repository.
method_specific_notes.PAML: Freeze the exact nucleotide ancestral-reconstruction subprogram/model.
method_specific_notes.POUTINE: Pin its TreeTime dependency and isolate homoplasy output from phenotype-association output.
method_specific_notes.SNPPar: Pin the documented TreeTime-compatible dependency set; do not silently upgrade TreeTime.

explicitly_unbenchmarked_endpoints.clade_lineage_marker_discovery: No feasibility-qualified external comparator exposes a sufficiently equivalent strict clade-exclusive nucleotide-marker endpoint for a fair quantitative benchmark. This absence is reported rather than forcing a mismatched comparison.
explicitly_unbenchmarked_endpoints.marker_deployment_genotyping: No feasibility-qualified method provides a like-for-like marker-deployment genotyping endpoint under the frozen benchmark universe.

before_environment_build: freeze source/release hashes or container digests where permitted
implement and unit-test canonical dataset generator
implement and unit-test each input/output adapter
prove no benchmark truth is supplied to comparator commands
implementation_gates.implementation_blocking_rule: If exact reproducible installation/invocation cannot be implemented under the frozen scientific contract, mark the method IMPLEMENTATION_BLOCKED with evidence. Do not silently replace it with a fork/successor or alter the benchmark endpoint.
implementation_gates.smoke_test_policy: Implementation validation may later be authorized on dedicated noncanonical toy data. Canonical 150-scenario benchmark data must not be used for parameter tuning or debugging.

metric_aggregation.confidence_intervals: Bootstrap scenario replicates only after the full frozen result exists; no resampling-based tuning.
metric_aggregation.overall_summary: Macro-average cell-level metrics so large datasets do not dominate by event count.
metric_aggregation.primary_summary: Report median and interquartile range across the five replicates within each size/regime/observation cell.
metric_aggregation.unit_first: Compute metrics per scenario before aggregation.

next_gate_note: Implement the frozen generator, adapters, metric engine and per-method environment/install recipes under a separately frozen implementation. Canonical software installation or benchmark execution remains unauthorized until subsequent authorization.

resource_and_failure_policy.nonzero_exit_handling: Preserve stdout/stderr/command/environment metadata. Do not modify parameters after truth is inspected. Any remediation requires a separately recorded implementation amendment.
resource_and_failure_policy.timeout_handling: A timeout is a completion failure and is reported separately; it is never scored as zero scientific accuracy.
resource_and_failure_policy.unsupported_scenario_handling: If a method's documented input contract cannot represent a frozen scenario, record UNSUPPORTED_BY_METHOD_CONTRACT rather than fabricating an adapter.

truth_generation.implementation_independence: Truth generation must be implemented in repository code without importing, calling or reproducing algorithms from BRANCHSNV or any comparator.
truth_generation.seed_policy: A single master seed and all derived scenario seeds must be frozen in the implementation freeze before any canonical dataset generation.
